whyAllGlobalOrgOnly.mechanism: HOTEL_OPPORTUNITY always adds Demand Generators → GLOBAL_ORG_ONLY unless Group Demand Opportunities eligibility is also met (confirmed/reliable demandThesis enum + credible commercial entry point).
whyAllGlobalOrgOnly.note: Sanitized persistence payloads from STAGED packages typically carry narrative hotelOpportunityThesis, not DEMAND_THESIS_STANDARD enums — so GDO remains deferred while research inventory still persists.
